integrity: The proof is symbolic and self-contained. The motivating source is used only for the complex-field theorem and its hypotheses; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The example refutes characteristic-free extension of the general reflexive-hull theorem but does not realize the chosen Lie subalgebra as a derivation algebra.
Odd positive characteristic is not classified.
title: A minimal characteristic-two obstruction to Lie closure of algebraic reflexive hulls
